_comment: A rounded lump, built the way Minecraft always builds a ball: three intersecting boxes whose
corners cancel, so the silhouette steps in at every corner instead of being a cube. It sits on
the floor and is 10px tall -- charas is scarce and this is nine of it, not a building block, so
it should read as an object on a shelf rather than as masonry.
ambientocclusion off: AO on a small multi-box shape smears a false shadow across the seams
where the boxes meet, which is exactly where the silhouette needs to stay crisp.

elements.__comment: the east-west bulge, which knocks the north and south corners off
the north-south bulge, which knocks the east and west corners off
